body:
Round-1 reworks are pushed and CI Build is green on both.
- #2581 (BUG-1971) at cd4d60fa5f: M2 now fails 2 tests. Items 2-4 are addressed, each with a mutation-proven test. Open point for you: in item 3, resume fails closed for a subdir or a non-git cwd, but the main checkout root itself is still granted, because its root == its git root. Requiring a linked worktree would close that, but it needs your call on where reviewer resume runs. Details are in the PR comment.
- #2582 (BUG-1972) at e241935dc0: there is no probe when --url differs, and the equivalent-URL and no-url cases are tested (mutations a and M5 are caught). Redaction is extended and the doc nit is added.
Both are ready for round-2 review. check-ci-fast passed 27/27 on each.
subject: #2581/#2582 round-1 rework pushed, CI green
